memory_candidates.content: When a generator must retain unrecognised-structure authored content verbatim (e.g. a markdown file whose section vocabulary varies by author), split sections by LINE-NUMBER POSITION from a single grep -n pass rather than by re-matching header text. Text-based re-extraction (like awk matching $0==header) silently mis-captures or merges content if the same header string appears twice. Position-based splitting is robust to duplicate headers and requires no assumption about the vocabulary's uniqueness.

Before adding a destructive write-mode's structural safety gate (e.g. 'refuse on unrecognised input shape'), land the gate in its own phase/commit BEFORE fixing the underlying crash that currently makes the dangerous case fail loudly. Fixing the crash first (removing the loud failure) without the gate in place would silently convert a loud crash into a successful, destructive overwrite on exactly the input the crash was protecting against. Phase-order the safety gate strictly before the crash fix.

Under `set -euo pipefail`, a pipeline whose leading command can legitimately return no matches (e.g. grep over an optional/empty section) needs an explicit `|| true` at the end of the WHOLE pipeline, not just a guard on the final command. Command substitution still captures the pipeline's stdout correctly even when `|| true` overrides a nonzero exit status, since stdout capture and exit-status propagation are independent in bash.
